mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.5%) indicates a weak labor market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 9.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong economic demand and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in GDPC1 and HOUST does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 220, indicating elevated inflation, the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above 90 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 550 thousand units signals a weakening housing market and reduced economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 550 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a labor market overheating without corresponding consumer demand, signaling potential economic imbalances and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint behavior of PAYEMS and RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative policy supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
